source_refs.note: Roman Urdu explanation of Topic 5.5.1.1 (PDF 146, printed 143).

blocks.text: Bar charts alag alag categories ka comparison (muqabla) karne ke liye behtareen hain. Har bar ek category hai, aur bar ki height (unchai) ya length (lambai) us category ki qeemat batati hai.
Misal: Socho aap dukaan mein alag alag products ki sales ka comparison karna chahte hain. Bar chart yeh data tasveer mein dikha sakta hai.

blocks.alt: Bar chart jis ka title Sales on Day 1 and Day 2 for various items hai. Y-axis (khari line), Number of products sold, 1000 tak. Chaar jore bars (Day 1 neela, Day 2 peela): 800 aur 600; 800 aur 1000; 1000 aur 600; 400 aur 600.
blocks.caption: Figure 5.4: Alag alag products ki sales dikhane wala bar chart (kitab ki Figure 5.4 jaisa hamara apna diagram).

blocks.prompt: Day 1 aur Day 2 ki sales ke liye saath saath (grouped) bars kyun useful (kaam ke) hain?
blocks.explanation: Har product ki do bars saath saath hoti hain, is liye har product ke liye dono dinon ka farq foran nazar aata hai.

items: Bar chart: categories ki qeematon ka comparison.
